title: Domestic violence policies; standard of conduct policies.
bodyText: Each county police department shall post its policies relating to domestic violence, officer-involved domestic violence, and standards of conduct on its official website.
bodyHtml: [§52D-16]  Domestic violence policies; standard of conduct policies.  Each county police department shall post its policies relating to domestic violence, officer-involved domestic violence, and standards of conduct on its official website. [L 2015, c 30, §2]
